summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases and a non-node input test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 tests) under the prepared venv. Not verified: mypy, black, isort, and ruff are not installed in that venv and I did not install them, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked only by hand (no lines over 88 columns). Nothing was committed.
